title: Floor quotient with a negative divisor
description: Return a divided by b, rounded down toward negative infinity (the largest integer that is not greater than the exact quotient). a and b may each be negative; b is never 0. For example 7 divided by -2 is -3.5, which rounds down to -4, and -7 divided by -2 is 3.5, which rounds down to 3.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
